data.revised_prompt:
Create a clean HD 2D game FX sprite sheet on a solid #FF00FF background, exactly 2 rows by 2 columns with four animation frames arranged evenly like a simple grid. Use the provided guide only as a placement reference: each frame centered in its cell, consistent scale, contained within the central 65% of each cell, with generous margins so nothing crosses cell edges. Do NOT draw any guide lines, borders, labels, safe-area marks, or cell outlines. No playing card, no explosion, no fire, no smoke, no fragments, no tearing, no UI, no text, no icons.

Design a universal special-card trigger effect: a soft pastel rainbow chrysanthemum halo, elegant and readable at small card size.

Frame 1 (top-left): small white center glow with a very faint pastel tint, minimal petals just beginning.
Frame 2 (top-right): soft radial petals unfold evenly in gold, cyan, pink, and white, slightly brighter and larger.
Frame 3 (bottom-left): full circular flower-like light halo, refined elegant rays, sparkling rim, luminous but soft.
Frame 4 (bottom-right): pastel rays fade into clean white glints and a translucent ring, airy and polished.

The effect should be centered in each cell, consistent in scale across frames, with smooth pastel gradients, subtle sparkle, premium fantasy card-game feel, no harsh outlines, no debris, no smoke. Keep the background outside the FX a pure solid #FF00FF. Ensure the sprite sheet is clear, neatly arranged, and highly readable as four discrete animation frames.
